notes.title: Our big Quality of Life update is now A-VAILABLE!
notes.content:
Hey all,

We finally got our big Quality of Life update out! Hopefully this update helps make the game smoother and more accessible for more people. There'll be hotfixes in the coming days to fix a few random things that have come up, but we're happy with how the game is coming together!

Next update will contain some new content, so stay tuned!

As always, patch notes below!

[h1]Version 0.3236.cb9136d8[/h1]

[h2]New Features[/h2]
[list]
[*] It's the accessibility update! We have a whole suite of new options in the options menu. This includes things like turning off Film Grain as well as bobbing of characters, and a bunch of wiggly animations. Hopefully this helps make the game more accessible for all sorts of people!
[*] Replaying stories is now available. Go chat to Ferran in the Locker Room or Odette in the Cafe to have them recount your previous exploits!
[*] Fast-forwarding stories is now possible, letting you skip over most dialogue if you so desire!
[*] A new colour scheme "Fakie" is now available, courtesy of tournament winner Minimal! Congrats!
[/list]

[h2]Balance Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Perceptive now gives you +1 to the attack stat that would hit the opponent the hardest (in addition to its old reveal effect)
[*] Balanced has been changed to Centered: You cannot have your stats lowered or feel any feelings.
[*] You can now do more damage than your opponent has health.
[*] Captain Clint now has 2 batteries. (Up from 1)
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] The damage calculator has been fixed for certain edge cases in which its prediction would be wildly off.
[*] Fel's "I CAN'T CONTROL IT" state has been fixed to not trigger more than once.
[*] Haughty no longer reveals itself when you tag out.
[/list]

notes.title: Hotfix for 14/04/21
notes.content:
[h2]Version 0.3236.5447677d[/h2]
•	Sympathetic has been streamlined to work with feelings given from any source.
•	Refund Locket no longer triggers while you are Sad
•	Lise's captain plan can no longer be parried
•	Tiebreaker token is now reliable again
•	Stat up/down messages have been tweaked
•	In-game descriptions with inconsistencies and typos have been fixed.
•	Riding Crop's critical hit can no longer be parried
•	Forgetful now triggers earlier than other Tag In moves to allow for interactions with other Tag In effects that make more sense
•	Character icons should no longer disappear in the team builder

notes.title: Pema has arrived!
notes.content:
Pema has entered the ring! This Pugilist/Admin will be throwing heavy haymakers and firewalls all over the place.

Just look at this damage versus the usually bulky Keiban!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34615756/737b251e61e97afd07537c25655442206d1bd56b.png[/img]

Go talk to Lottie to meet Pema. You may need to get to know a few other fighters first.

As always, patch notes below!

[h2]Version 0.3236.e01b33c5[/h2]
[h3]New Features[/h3]
[list][*]     Pema the Powerful is now available! Go talk to Lottie to meet her, though you may need to meet some other fighters first! She has a special locket to give you.
[*]     Windows users will now have their task bar flash when an online match is made! No more worries about minimizing the window!
[*]     There is an SFX that now plays whenever a match is found!
[*]     New colour scheme, Caution, is now purchasable from Amma! Thank recent tournament winner KAZ, for the scheme. It looks great![/list]
[h3]Tweaks[/h3]
[list][*]     The UI click SFX has been softened significantly
[*]     Cheer now has a new SFX
[*]     Keiban has been re-rendered to have less aliasing in his sprites
[*]     Cherry's headphone mic colour has been adjusted to be consistent between frames.
[*]     Cherry's UP and DOWN stat effects are no longer sideways
[*]     Euler's intro fight has been tweaked slightly
[*]     The damage estimator is now much more robust, accounting for flourishes, Alarm Pendant, Critical Hits, and more[/list]
[h3]Bug fixes[/h3]
[list][*]     Fashion Advice's necklace break should no longer pierce parry
[*]     Fel's I CAN'T CONTROL IT graphic remains even if the trait is swapped. I CAN'T CONTROL IT is given after most move effects, and is therefore harder to get rid of with flourished Fashion Advice.
[*]     Vicious no longer makes the battle hang for half a second when triggered
[*]     Tired now only triggers if you had Tired before you used a move[/list]
[h3]Balance Changes[/h3][list]
[*]     Tazu -10 EDef
[*]     Backlash only deals 5 damage
[*]     Lise -5 PDef
[*]     Captain Lise now only causes Sad 3 (down from 4)
[*]     Yasmiin +25 PAtk
[*]     Ambidextrous now deals only 50% damage on the second hit.
[*]     Tough trait makes it impossible for you to be hit by a crit.
[*]     Captain Yasmiin now gains 20 Heart when a teammate is hit.
[*]     Vivid doubles stat changes applied to your fighter
[*]     Eerie now causes Trapped 3 (up from 2) 
[*]     Cherry +20 EDef
[*]     Captain Cherry now has 1 battery, but cannot use that battery to flourish.
[*]     Wendel +20 PAtk, -30 DAtk
[*]     Annora +20 PAtk, +10 Init
[*]     Captain Annora now grants 3 charge instead of 2 when you flourish.
[*]     Volante (unreleased as of right now), has been given +30 PDef
[*]     Flourish Deep Breath no longer improves your Init.
[*]     Scanner now reveals what your opponent has equipped.
[*]     Burn Bright's stat downs have been halved.
[*]     Escape Whip's effect has been changed from AFTER DAMAGE to AFTER USE, making it more versatile.
[*]     Extrovert (unreleased as of right now), has been changed to make all emotional attacks you use to heal you by 25% of the damage dealt.
[*]     Captain Ferran now has 4 batteries (up from 3)
[*]     Gripping is now Legendary, it causes Dizzy any time you apply Trapped to a foe.
[*]     Peck reduced to 50 POW (from 60)
[*]     Hand Cannon's flourish is now only 50% damage (up from 25%)
[*]     Flourish Mentor now heals your mentee's feelings[/list]

notes.title: New Palettes! New Chassis!
notes.content:
Hey all, we're so glad you've been enjoying the game. This is just a lil' patch to give you a bunch more cosmetic options! Included are a bunch more pride flags, and some new chassis options. Worth highlighting is JB, the colour scheme by our very first community tournament winner, Bolimar! Go talk to Amma and Yasmiin to explore your new options! Below are the new colour schemes, and further below are the full patch notes!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34615756/b9ab2e11bc9d7693f050937d0192d51cd8896cef.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34615756/de3ec3b29459f1503392f561bd81d57dcc93690b.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34615756/a3051b0b331417876e4aed83ed171acaab7e2fea.png[/img]

Enjoy!

xoxo,
GLOAM

[u]Below are the full patch notes![/u]

[h1]Version 0.3236.e6c43edc[/h1]

[h2]New Stuff[/h2]

[list]
[*]     A bunch of new colour schemes! Go talk to Amma!
[*]     A bunch of new becker chassis! Go talk to Yasmiin!
[/list]

[h2]Tweaks[/h2]

[list]
[*]     Sway cost for some items adjusted
[*]     Every fighter now starts with an extra move they're confident in
[/list]


[h2]Balance Changes[/h2]

[list]
[*]     Decoy now has 2 uses (up from 1)
[*]     Sob Story now has 2 uses (up from 1)
[*]     Peck now has 4 uses (down from 8)
[*]     Charge Panel no longer fails if at max battery
[*]     Heart to Heart now shares Heart in an even 50/50 split
[*]     Ferroskin adds +8 to PDef on flourish, in addition to swapping your trait to Tough
[*]     Tenacious limits damage to 99, identical to Gloam Locket
[*]     Keiban Captain now has 3 batteries (down from 4)
[*]     Annora Captain now has 2 batteries (up from 1)
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]

[list]
[*]     You can now reliably cancel out of matchmaking
[*]     A handful of strange interactions involving Proxy & Snub have been fixed
[*]     Round End was tagging out Jane before her Acidic Armor was taking effect
[*]     Topaz Locket now triggers, even on forfeit
[*]     Disruption wave clears popups, even if there isn't an opponent
[*]     Refund Locket now triggers before damage is calculated, in order for Riding Crop to take advantage of it
[/list]

notes.title: Grace and Ranked Matchmaking now playable!
notes.content:
Our first content patch just dropped! In it you can finally recruit fan favourite Grace, as well as test your skills online in Ranked matchmaking! We hope you enjoy, and thank you so much for a fantastic launch week.

If you haven't yet, we ask you to consider [url=http://discord.gg/bravery]joining our Discord![/url] We have a warm and welcoming community that have all been doing an amazing job sharing strategies, organizing a tournament, setting up a wiki, and more! We'd love to see you there, if you're interested!

And now for detailed patch notes below!

[h1][b]VERSION 0.3236.b10cecde[/b][/h1]
[h2]
New Features[/h2]

[list]
[*]     Grace added to the game! Go to Lottie to meet her, but you may need to get to know some other characters first!
[*]     Ranked play added to the game! Head over to the stadium and see if you have what it takes to become the Bravest?
[*]     Critical Hits now have a juicy effect applied to them!
[*]     Announcements from GLOAM will now appear for tournaments, server maintenance and more!
[/list]

[h2]
Balance Changes[/h2]

[list]
[*]     Hand Cannon changed to 80 POW
[*]     Topaz Locket now triggers AFTER Disruption Wave
[*]     Balanced now blocks other fighters from lowering stats
[*]     Round End now clears ALL your stat changes
[*]     Ambidextrous Claymore with Balm Locket will now clear the stat change in-between attacks
[*]     Vicious now deals minimum 30 damage
[/list]


[h2]Tweaks
[/h2]
[list]
[*]     Zael's default Focus optimized
[*]     Relaxed matchmaking restrictions
[*]     Cherry's default colour scheme changed to Black Forest
[*]     The beginner fighters default colour schemes swapped
[*]     Feral's excited trigger is now more consistently activated
[*]     Damage type tutorial tweaked so Ferran doesn't have gripping
[*]     An attempted fix at Steam User Ticket error
[*]     Quit button now appears alongside some error messages
[*]     Molly's feelings tutorial sped up slightly
[*]     Wendel now needs the cafe unlocked first, before you can recruit him
[*]     Sway gain tweaked for Radney and story fights! (more to come!!)
[/list]

[h2]
Bug Fixes[/h2]

[list]
[*]     BAD KEY for NPC captain plans nixed
[*]     Ferran's captain plan no longer has an edge-case that crashes battles
[*]     Alarm pendant should reveal (not super clear yet, but it's better)
[*]     Puzzle pendant should reveal (not super clear yet, but it's better)
[*]     Disruption Wave will still clear if taken out by Backlash or similar effects.
[*]     Impressionable will no longer throw an error for tagging out.
[*]     Coffee now clears bad stats (whoops!)
[*]     Captain Zael now gains charge by clearing SAD before attacking with a digital attack
[*]     Proxy's damage estimate fixed
[*]     Zael no longer creepily shows up behind Fel's vignette end
[/list]

notes.title: Demo Playtest Signups!
notes.content:
Hey everyone! 

It's Min again from Gloam, this is our [i]SECOND POST[/i], which is a tragedy, because we've had so many things we've wanted to share, but due to some unfortunate circumstances we haven't been able to update on here for a while. So thanks for your patience with us.

Now that things are back up and running, we're happy to be here with some good news! 💪

[h1]Sign up to playtest our demo![/h1]
We're having a Demo Playtest in the next few weeks and are looking for volunteers that want to get their hands on an early version of the game! You're also welcome to get your friends to sign up and you'll be allowed to share screenshots, video, and even stream it!

Feel free to check out the sign-up form for more details, here:

[url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSeoNKeCQdsIbR_Fg84oUtD13xc9d9xKyaBYfpeyLByggyF-QA/viewform]>>>DEMO SIGN UP<<<[/url]

Hopefully you all enjoy it, we're excited to get it into people's hands and to see how it functions with more players! Obviously the game is still early and is a work in progress, so expect bugs, crashes, and all that fun stuff.

[h1]Discord[/h1]

If you haven't joined our Discord yet, feel free to! For the demo, we'll be prioritizing players who are on our Discord, so it's easier to communicate. We've got that up and running over here: [url=https://discord.gg/bravery]https://discord.gg/bravery[/url]

[h1]Twitch[/h1]
[url=https://www.twitch.tv/gloamco]https://www.twitch.tv/gloamco[/url]
We also have started up a twitch channel, so if you want to follow along we've been streaming progress on the game at least once a week! Usually it's Damian, but sometimes I'm on there too! Come hang out.

[h1]BNO in the News[/h1]
8 Minutes of gameplay footage was revealed on IGN last month!
[url=https://www.ign.com/videos/bravery-network-online-8-minutes-of-gameplay]https://www.ign.com/videos/bravery-network-online-8-minutes-of-gameplay[/url]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34615756/78b668eb17a2af31eb05209bad54025cf35f9b55.png[/img]

Thank you all for your support, we're really excited to share more with you so so soon!

xoxo

- Min-Taylor & [url=http://www.gloamcollective.com/]Gloam[/url]

notes.title: Events Event Events!
notes.content:
Hey all, 
it's Min from Gloam and this is our first Steam announcement! 
*gestures hands around excitedly and also badly*

First of all we want to thank you all for wishlisting our game, it means a lot to us that you're excited about it! Your support is something we honestly really appreciate. We're also real excited to share more updates and fun stuff as the game comes along!

For today though, I just wanted to say that we're doing a couple events really soon! Here's the details:

[h1]The MIX @ GDC[/h1]
[i]San Francisco, CA[/i]
BNO is going to be featured at The MIX during GDC, on Monday night. This is more of an industry event, but if you're going to The MIX we'll be there!
https://www.mediaindieexchange.com/

[h1]PAX East[/h1]
[i]Boston, MA[/i]
We're going to have a booth at PAX East! Which is super exciting (I've never been before). If you're going to PAX East come check us out and play Bravery Network Online 💪 You can find us at booth 22015. We're excited to meet you!
